contracts.obligation: Completed compaction and prune rewrites invalidate every active or suspended Codex epoch. Across HTTP/WebSocket and append-only off/on/auto, the next provider request is a fresh full baseline with no stale anchor or connection metadata, removed history is absent, retained summary/system/tools/paired tool call-result/steering appear exactly once, and normal append resumes. Repeated rewrites, late old completions, close failures, and failed or aborted rewrites preserve the same boundary.

At the verified Z.AI Anthropic boundary, structured numeric or string vendor code 1113 is preserved as providerErrorCode and canonicalized to providerCode insufficient_quota. Numeric/string and default/5+ fallback budgets each produce exactly one Z.AI HTTP request, one fallback request, one quota switch with attemptsUsed 1, and one accepted user/assistant lifecycle.
